name: 旅費項目と参照基準を変更
summary: 区長や議員などの旅費・費用弁償は、複数の条例で定めています。議案では、旅費の項目名を改め、区長と副区長の旅費額の参照基準を東京都の条例から国の政令に基づく基準へ変更します。
changes: 旅費の項目名を改める
旅費額の参照先を東京都の条例から国の政令に基づく基準に改める
why: 旅費及び費用弁償に関する規定を改める必要があるためと、区は説明しています。

en.name: Changes travel expense categories and reference standards
en.official: Ordinance Partially Amending the Ordinance on Salaries, etc. of the Mayor and Deputy Mayor of Itabashi City, etc.
en.summary: Travel expenses and expense reimbursements for the mayor, assembly members and others are set out in several ordinances. The bill changes the names of travel expense categories and changes the reference standard for the mayor’s and deputy mayor’s travel expense amounts from a Tokyo ordinance to standards based on a national Cabinet Order.
changes: Changes the names of travel expense categories
Changes the reference for travel expense amounts from a Tokyo ordinance to standards based on a national Cabinet Order
en.why: The ward says it is necessary to amend the provisions concerning travel expenses and expense reimbursements.
